limitations: The public archive is dynamically rendered; BetterMakati does not yet possess a normalized complete local record set.
Archive discovery does not itself provide a complete lifecycle chain for filing, committee referral, readings, vote, transmittal, mayoral action and implementation.
Individual document structure varies by year/document, so fields must be nullable/evidence-backed rather than assumed.

observedCapabilities: The official Makati portal currently surfaces regular City Council session videos under Makati Latest Videos.

Current examples visible during the audit include regular council sessions dated 21 September 2026, 14 September 2026, 7 September 2026, 1 September 2026, 24 August 2026, 17 August 2026, 11 August 2026, 3 August 2026 and 27 July 2026.
officialSourceFindings.limitation: The visible current stream demonstrates strong session coverage but this audit does not claim every 2026 regular/special session is complete until dates are enumerated against an official calendar or session sequence.

officialSourceFindings.limitation: Direct Facebook retrieval was unavailable in this audit environment. A specific session should be linked only when the official post/recording URL can be preserved.

officialSourceFindings.publisher: City Government of Makati — Office of the Secretary to the Sangguniang Panlungsod

officialSourceFindings.note: BetterMakati should point to this service when a needed official text is not publicly downloadable or when a certified copy is required.

sourceOwnershipModel.note: A session video may corroborate deliberation/action but cannot replace the official measure text.

sourceOwnershipModel.canonicalEvidenceOwner: official Makati portal video / preserved official MyMakati recording, plus agenda/minutes when located
sourceOwnershipModel.note: One session can relate to many measures; do not duplicate the video URL into unrelated measure data without an explicit relationship.
Keep distinct from Makati City Council legislation.

sourceOwnershipModel.canonicalEvidenceOwner: Office of the Secretary to the Sangguniang Panlungsod
sourceOwnershipModel.note: BetterMakati should not claim that its copy substitutes for a certified copy.

lifecycleEvidenceRules: Measure number/title/type from the official archive/document may identify the canonical local legislation record.
Session date from an official measure document may establish enactment/session evidence when explicitly stated.
A session video establishes that a recording of the session exists; it does not automatically establish that a particular measure passed, the vote tally, or mayoral action.
A measure may link to a session video only when the measure/session relationship is explicit in official text, agenda/minutes, the recording, or reviewed session evidence.
Authors/sponsors are recorded only as stated by the official record; do not infer authorship from who spoke in a session video.
Later ordinances that amend/repeal earlier measures should use explicit measure-to-measure relationships rather than free-text-only notes.
schemaRequirementsExposedByAudit: Stable local measure ID independent of title.
Official text/document URL plus source provenance.
Enactment/approval/session dates as separate nullable evidence-backed dates.
Lifecycle events with event type, date, source and confidence/evidence status rather than one guessed status string.
Session-evidence relationships, including official portal/MyMakati video URL and later agenda/minutes when available.
Typed relationships to barangays, services, canonical Place Registry assets, projects/accountability records, Public Records, reports and BetterGov ecosystem resources.
Record-access fallback to OSSP certified-copy service.
Explicit separation of local legislation from national bills/laws.

auditDecision.mostImportantCorrection: Council-session video availability is not a current source gap. The official Makati portal is visibly publishing 2026 regular council-session videos; the remaining gap is normalization, completeness checking, agendas/minutes/votes and measure-session linking.
auditDecision.nextSchemaDirection: W4-2b should model ordinances/resolutions as canonical local measures and model session evidence as typed relationships/documents, so the same session recording can be reused by City Monitor, Legislation, Public Records and later Reports without duplication.

nextStep.title: Define local legislation registry schema
nextStep.maximumScope: Schema only for ordinances/resolutions plus typed council-session evidence: identifier, number, title, type, dates, official text, authors when stated, lifecycle events, session video/agenda/minutes relationships, civic relationships and provenance.
